newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lankan rupee ends steady, no commercial deals.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lankan rupee ends steady, no commercial deals.

text.p: The Sri Lankan rupee ended at its opening level of 55.62 to the dollar on Friday after ramining in a tight three-cent range for the whole day, dealers said.

They said a lack of commercial deals and the dollar's steady trend overseas limited the rupee's movement. The Centrtal Bank did not provide any impetus by keeping its exchange rate intact. The rupee closed at 55.57 on Thursday.

"Today's Australia-Sri Lanka match put the lid on the forex market," a foreign bank dealer said, referring to a cricket match. The overnight call rate ended at 14.5 percent after opening at 14 percent. -- Prithi Kodagoda (941) 434319
